after.rosterkit/seating.py:
# owner: platform
"""Lay students out in seating rows."""

from typing import List, Sequence

from rosterkit.models import Student
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError


def _sort_key(student: Student) -> tuple:
    return (student.last_name, student.first_name)


def _row_line(number: int, chunk: Sequence[Student]) -> str:
    names = " | ".join(item.display_name for item in chunk)
    return f"Row {number}: {names}"


# ---
def seating_rows(students: Sequence[Student], per_row: int) -> List[str]:
    """One line per row, students sorted by last name."""
    if per_row < 1 or not students:
        raise ProjectError("need at least one student and one seat per row")
    ordered = sorted(students, key=_sort_key)
    rows = [ordered[start:start + per_row] for start in range(0, len(ordered), per_row)]
    return [_row_line(index, chunk) for index, chunk in enumerate(rows, 1)]
